notes.title: Patch notes Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We have a quick update for you guys!

1.02 changelog (Don't need to reset save files)

Steam:
[olist]
 Added webm opening movie file for SteamOS users.
 Fixed an issue causing the game to crash when the game or save file path includes characters that are neither English nor Japanese.
 Added Windows 11 ARM support.
[/olist]

notes.title: IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI - THE COLORFUL WORLD RELEASE DATE AND GIVEAWAY!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are super excited for our first game developed by FAVORITE!
IROTORIDORI NO SEKAI - THE COLORFUL WORLD will be released on Friday the 16th of February!
Check out the store page and put it on your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591380/Irotoridori_No_Sekai__The_Colorful_World/

To celebrate the upcoming release of "Irotoridori no Sekai: The Colorful World", we're giving away Steam keys! 
Check out the giveaway here -> https://twitter.com/NekoNyanSoft/status/1756907348512080239
